capabilities: Hide individual Bases toolbar buttons per .base file via settings or YAML
Apply the same toolbar rules to embedded bases in notes
Add custom view-switcher buttons with icons or labels and a default button
Reorder custom buttons by drag and drop
Enable a wrapping toolbar style for narrow embeds
extras: Not yet in the community plugin catalogue; must be installed manually from releases. Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer.
intentEvidence: Configure which toolbar buttons are visible in Obsidian Bases — both in standalone .base files and in embedded bases
motivation: The README frames the goal as keeping the UI clean: 'Add custom view-switcher buttons, hide what you don't use, and keep the UI clean.'
problem: Bases toolbars show a fixed set of buttons that cannot be hidden per file, and frequently used views cannot be pinned as quick-switch buttons.
summary: Toolbar configurator for Obsidian Bases that hides toolbar buttons per .base file and adds custom view-switcher buttons, including in embeds.
